convertibility_reason: Uses iCustom to load ColorSchaffTrendCycle custom indicator and depends on two external .mqh libraries (SmoothAlgorithms.mqh, TradeAlgorithms.mqh) for smoothing algorithms and trade execution logic

derived_values.name: min_rates_total - minimum bars required for indicator calculation
TimeShiftSec - chart period in seconds
derived_values.used_by: UpSignalTime and DnSignalTime calculation for trade execution timing

other_exits: Sell signal triggers BuyPosClose when BuyPosClose input is true; Buy signal triggers SellPosClose when SellPosClose input is true

position_sizing.conditional_logic: negative MM values = fixed lot size (absolute value); positive MM values = deposit fraction for risk-based sizing

custom_logic_notes: Signal logic uses buffer 1 of the ColorSchaffTrendCycle indicator. Buy signal: SigValue[1]>6 AND (if SignalBar!=0) new bar detected; additional check SigValue[0]>=6 confirms trend strength. Sell signal: SigValue[1]<2 AND SigValue[0]>=2 confirms trend strength. The SignalBar=0 case bypasses the new-bar check allowing intrabar recalculation. Trade execution functions (BuyPositionOpen, SellPositionOpen, BuyPositionClose, SellPositionClose) come from TradeAlgorithms.mqh - actual position checking and order logic is encapsulated in that library. Recount flag triggers signal recalculation on next tick if CopyBuffer fails.
python_conversion_notes: The ColorSchaffTrendCycle custom indicator must be reimplemented in Python - it is a Schaff Trend Cycle oscillator that combines double smoothed stochastic with MACD-style convergence/divergence. The indicator buffer 1 maps to color index values (0-8 range) not raw oscillator values, so the signal thresholds of 6 and 2 correspond to color-coded trend zones. SmoothAlgorithms.mqh provides CXMA class with GetStartBars() and multiple smoothing methods (JJMA, JurX, ParMA, T3, VIDYA, AMA beyond standard SMA/EMA/SMMA/LWMA). TradeAlgorithms.mqh provides BuyPositionOpen/SellPositionOpen/BuyPositionClose/SellPositionClose with built-in position management - must reverse-engineer or reimplement these. The MM parameter dual behavior (negative=lot, positive=deposit fraction) must be preserved. SL/TP are in points (not pips) so digit adjustment logic must be handled in Python conversion. The LoadHistory() and IsNewBar() utilities from TradeAlgorithms.mqh must also be replicated.
